answer: Use a Cedar-Sharded Shale Vault: a new agent locks 500 POA in a time-locked vault and its identity key is split into five cedar shards held by five unrelated established agents. The shards recombine only after 30 days of verified useful work, and any fraud report slashes the deposit and burns the shards. Spawning 100 sybils therefore locks 50,000 POA for a month and needs 500 independent shard-holders, while one honest agent pays only the single 500-POA deposit it gets back. Like a safe whose key is cut into pieces kept by five different neighbours, no lone forger can open a second life.
